stack.test_framework: shellcheck (static) + compose smoke boot in CI

key_layers.name: Compose services
key_layers.responsibility: All local services, gated by profiles: core (postgres), quality (sonarqube), tools (adminer)

key_layers.name: Postgres init
key_layers.responsibility: First-boot SQL: one database + owner user per consumer service

key_layers.name: SonarQube bootstrap
key_layers.responsibility: Idempotent first-run config: admin password, projects, tokens, shared quality gate

key_layers.name: Docs
key_layers.responsibility: INFRASTRUCTURE.md (plan + port registry), RUNBOOK.md, adr/, CODEMAPS/

external_deps.purpose: First consumer — its application.properties defines the DB/port contract this repo must satisfy

gotchas: postgres/init/*.sql runs ONLY on first boot (empty volume) — adding a service later needs make nuke or a live-SQL helper
Compose credentials/ports must stay in sync with ../feature_flag/src/main/resources/application.properties — drift breaks the app silently
The port table in docs/INFRASTRUCTURE.md is the workspace-wide port registry — claim ports there before adding services
Consumer apps run on the HOST (./mvnw spring-boot:run), only stateful dependencies run in Docker
SonarQube Community analyzes one branch per project — no PR analysis locally
test_isolation: shellcheck for scripts; CI boots the core profile and asserts Postgres health
sensitive_areas: postgres/init/ — credential definitions consumed by sibling repos
.claude/hooks/ — harness enforcement (memory gate); changes need explicit confirmation
docker-compose.yml port mappings — collisions break other workspace services

conventions.coverage_target: n/a (infra repo — CI gate is compose boot + shellcheck clean)
